question: Can a pass start the next one with the default workflow token?
pass: Yes (section 6), as the working rulings on #187 read it. A job of a workflow in the canary whose permissions grant actions: write and nothing else dispatches the same workflow once with its own GITHUB_TOKEN, with an input that stops the chain at two: the dispatch is answered 204; the second run's record shows event workflow_dispatch and names its actor; and the second run is in the list of the workflow's runs within P-22's bound, 60 seconds of the dispatch's Date header, which the fixture records either way.
